english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a store where books are bought and sold.
This is the all-purpose everyday word for a shop that sells books.

examples.english: This bookstore has lots of comics.
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 syu1 dim3 jau5 hou2 do1 maan4 waa2

examples.english: I went to the bookshop to buy a novel.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 syu1 dim3 maai5 bun2 siu2 syut3
